# mcloud build

<!-- Generated by `go run ./internal/gendocs`: edit the source it names, not this file. -->

_Generated from the command's help in `internal/cli`._

[All commands](README.md)

Build the app's image and push it to the maxcloud registry.

Build the app in the current repo (with its Dockerfile, else with Paketo
buildpacks) and push it to the maxcloud registry,
registry.gronblom.dev/&lt;app&gt;/&lt;app&gt;. mcloud is docker's credential helper
for the registry while it builds, so there's no docker login. image: in
maxcloud.yaml pushes somewhere else instead, with your own docker login
(not with --ci).

It builds the folder source: in maxcloud.yaml names (e.g. worker, when the
repo's root is something else), else the folder maxcloud.yaml is in. The
Dockerfile, if any, is looked for there.

--ci is the deploy workflow (run-deploy.yaml): it pushes as the repo (GitHub
Actions' OIDC token), writes the functions' manifests (--functions), pins
the image by digest in the manifests and commits that. Outside CI it
pushes with an hour-long token of the app's push ServiceAccount and prints
the image.

```
mcloud build [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--app` string |  | the app (--ci; default: maxcloud.yaml's) |
| `--ci` |  | the deploy workflow's build (GitHub Actions): build, push, generate, pin and commit |
| `--context` string |  | directory to build (--ci; default: source: in maxcloud.yaml, else .) |
| `--functions` |  | a maxcloud functions app: write its functions' manifests (--ci) |
| `--image` string | `app` | the image's name in the manifests, replaced by the built one (--ci) |
| `--manifests` string | `deploy/k8s` | the manifests directory Flux applies (--ci) |
